record.bible_text: But now <FI>they that are<Fi> younger<WH06810><WH03117> than I have me in derision<WH07832><WTH8804>, whose fathers<WH01> I would have disdained<WH03988><WTH8804> to have set<WH07896><WTH8800> with the dogs<WH03611> of my flock<WH06629>. <RF>younger...: Heb. of fewer days than I<Rf>

<FI> They were<Fi> children<WH01121> of fools<WH05036>, yea, children<WH01121> of base men<WH08034>: they were viler<WH05217><WTH8738> than the earth<WH0776>. <RF>base...: Heb. men of no name<Rf>

They came<WH0857><WTH8799> <FI>upon me<Fi> as a wide<WH07342> breaking<WH06556> in <FI>of waters<Fi> : in<WH08478> the desolation<WH07722> they rolled<WH01556><WTH8701> themselves <FI>upon me<Fi> .<CM>
